name: BEN_GAP_DAILY_ABSENCES
description: This table is used to store daily absence details like absence date, work pattern and the level of entitlement for an absence plan.

columns.name: ABSENCE_DATE
columns.description: The date of a day or fraction of a day of an absence.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_DAY_TYPE
columns.description: Work pattern day type WORKON or OFFWORK.

columns.name: LEVEL_OF_ENTITLEMENT
columns.description: Level of entitlement is the entitlement band info.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Duration for this day or a fraction of the day.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DURATION_IN_HOURS
columns.description: Duration for this day or a fraction of the day expressed in hours.

columns.name: WORKING_DAYS_PER_WEEK
columns.description: Average number of days per week that a person worked on this day of absence.

columns.name: FTE
columns.description: Full time equivalent of the assignment as of the absence date.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
